description: This file defines the class 'HTMLPurifier_ChildDef_Table' which is responsible for handling and validating the structure of HTML table child elements within the HTMLPurifier library. It contains logic for interpreting the rules and permissible elements within a table, including handling of captions, table sections (`thead`, `tfoot`, `tbody`), and table rows (`tr`).

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_ChildDef_Table
classes.description: A class that defines the validation logic for table child elements according to HTML specifications within the HTMLPurifier library.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor for the HTMLPurifier_ChildDef_Table class, currently does not perform any initialization.

methods.name: validateChildren
methods.description: Validates and processes the child elements of a table according to HTML specifications, handling special elements like caption, thead, tfoot, tbody, and tr, as well as whitespace and colgroup elements. Wraps stray tr elements in tbody if needed.
